title: Implement tip advertisement message format and publisher
description:
Define TipAdvertisement { group_name: String, tip_cids: Vec<Cid>, hlc_timestamp: HlcTimestamp, sender_peer_id: PeerId }. Serialize to canonical bytes. Implement publish_tip(group: &str, tips: &[Cid]) on GossipHandle: build, sign, and publish a TipAdvertisement to the hierarchy topic. Implement handle_tip_advertisement to update local tip tracking. Artifact: transit/src/gossip/tip_advert.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- TipAdvertisement serializes deterministically
- publish_tip sends a message that a peer's handle_tip_advertisement correctly parses
- Malformed messages are rejected with a logged warning, not a panic
- Unit test: publish on node A, receive on node B, tips match
